title: Files and folders specified in .gitignore are passed to session_context

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue is a clear and actionable bug report regarding gitignored files and directories being passed into session_context. Sufficient context and environment details are provided.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix involves a localized change in packages/core/src/utils/getFolderStructure.ts to ensure directories ignored by .gitignore / fileService are omitted rather than formatted as ignored stubs, along with updating test assertions in packages/core/src/utils/getFolderStructure.test.ts.

summary.problem: Directories specified in .gitignore are included in the session_context directory structure representation with a '...' suffix rather than being completely omitted.
summary.root_cause: In getFolderStructure.ts, readFullStructure checks fileService.shouldIgnoreDirectory for subdirectories. When a directory is flagged as ignored, it creates an ignoredSubFolder entry with isIgnored: true and includes it in subFoldersInCurrentDir, causing gitignored folders to appear in the directory context string.
summary.context: The directory structure in session_context is generated via getDirectoryContextString in environmentContext.ts, which calls getFolderStructure. While ignored files are filtered out, ignored directories are formatted as folderName/...

steps: Update readFullStructure in packages/core/src/utils/getFolderStructure.ts when processing subdirectories.
Differentiate between default explicitly ignored folders and directories ignored via fileService (.gitignore / .geminiignore).
Completely skip and omit subdirectories ignored by fileService from subFoldersInCurrentDir rather than adding them with isIgnored: true.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Directories ignored by .gitignore or .geminiignore will be completely excluded from the formatted directory structure in getFolderStructure and session_context.
verification_steps: Update unit tests in packages/core/src/utils/getFolderStructure.test.ts to verify that directories listed in .gitignore are omitted from the directory structure output.
Run Vitest tests for getFolderStructure to ensure all tests pass cleanly.
